146	def _function(tree: ast.Module, symbol: str | None):
147	    """The (async) function or method `symbol` ("f" or "Class.method"); the module if None."""
148	    if not symbol:
149	        return tree
150	    parts, scope = symbol.split("."), tree.body
151	    node = None
152	    for i, name in enumerate(parts):
153	        node = next((n for n in scope if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef,
154	                                                         ast.ClassDef)) and n.name == name), None)
155	        if node is None:
156	            return None
157	        scope = node.body
158	    return node

161	def _module_constants(tree: ast.Module) -> dict[str, ast.Assign]:
162	    return {t.id: n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and len(n.targets) == 1
163	            for t in n.targets if isinstance(t, ast.Name)
164	            and isinstance(n.value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(n.value.value, str)}

171	def _replace_spans(text: str, spans: list[tuple[tuple[int, int, int, int], str]]) -> str:
172	    """Replace single-line (line, col, end_line, end_col) spans; columns are UTF-8 offsets.
173	
174	    A span inside another one being rewritten (a constant's value inside its rewritten
175	    definition) is dropped; partly overlapping spans are refused."""
176	    def inside(a, b):     # a strictly within b, or equal
177	        return (b[0], b[1]) <= (a[0], a[1]) and (a[2], a[3]) <= (b[2], b[3])
178	    unique = list(dict(spans).items())
179	    keep = []
180	    for s, new in unique:
181	        width = (s[0], s[1]) != (s[2], s[3])
182	        if width and any(o != s and (o[0], o[1]) != (o[2], o[3]) and inside(s, o)
183	                         for o, _ in unique):
184	            continue
185	        keep.append((s, new))
186	    for i, (a, _) in enumerate(keep):
187	        for b, _ in keep[i + 1:]:
188	            if (a[0], a[1]) < (b[2], b[3]) and (b[0], b[1]) < (a[2], a[3]):
189	                raise EditError(f"line {a[0]}: overlapping edits can't be applied safely")
190	    lines = text.splitlines(True)
191	    for (ln, col, eln, ecol), new in sorted(keep, key=lambda s: s[0], reverse=True):
192	        if ln != eln:
193	            raise EditError(f"line {ln}: a multi-line expression can't be rewritten safely")
194	        raw = lines[ln - 1].encode("utf-8")
195	        lines[ln - 1] = (raw[:col] + new.encode("utf-8") + raw[ecol:]).decode("utf-8")
196	    return "".join(lines)

200	    up_old, up_new = old_provider.upper(), re.sub(r"\W", "_", new_provider.upper())
201	    return old.replace(up_old, up_new) if up_old in old else f"{up_new}_BASE_URL"

204	def edit_file(text: str, path: str, sites: list[Site], old: tuple[str, str], new: tuple[str, str],
205	              providers: dict) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
206	    """Switch every site in one file from model `old` to `new` ((provider, native) each).
207	
208	    Inside each site's function: the model literal becomes the new native id; when the
209	    provider changes, the old provider's base URL (a literal or a module constant used only
210	    by the edited sites) and API-key variable (code and comments) become the new provider's.
211	    Raises EditError when that can't be done completely and safely."""
212	    (old_p, old_m), (new_p, new_m) = old, new
213	    try:
214	        tree = ast.parse(text)
215	    except SyntaxError as e:
216	        raise EditError(f"{path} does not parse: {e}") from e
217	    consts = _module_constants(tree)
218	    old_cfg, new_cfg = providers.get(old_p) or {}, providers.get(new_p) or {}
219	    switch_provider = old_p != new_p
220	    if switch_provider and not (new_cfg.get("base_url") and new_cfg.get("key_env")):
221	        raise EditError(f"provider {new_p!r} has no base_url/key_env in the provider catalog")
222	    spans, notes, ranges, url_names = [], [], [], set()
223	    for site in sites:
224	        fn = _function(tree, site.symbol)
225	        if fn is None:
226	            raise EditError(f"{path}: {site.symbol} not found (the code changed since the graph "
227	                            "was read)")
228	        nodes = list(ast.walk(fn))
229	        ranges.append((fn.lineno, fn.end_lineno) if site.symbol else (1, len(text.splitlines())))
230	        literals = [n for n in nodes if isinstance(n, ast.Constant) and n.value == old_m]
231	        names = {n.id for n in nodes if isinstance(n, ast.Name) and isinstance(n.ctx, ast.Load)}
232	        model_consts = [c for c in names if c in consts and consts[c].value.value == old_m]
233	        if not literals and not model_consts:
234	            raise EditError(f"{site.describe()}: {old_m!r} no longer appears there")
235	        spans += [(_span(n), json.dumps(new_m)) for n in literals]
236	        for c in model_consts:
237	            spans.append((_span(consts[c].value), json.dumps(new_m)))
238	            notes.append(f"module constant {c} now names {new_m!r}")
239	        if not switch_provider:
240	            continue
241	        url_lits = [n for n in nodes if isinstance(n, ast.Constant)
242	                    and n.value == old_cfg.get("base_url")]
243	        url_consts = {c for c in names if c in consts
244	                      and consts[c].value.value == old_cfg.get("base_url")}
245	        key_lits = [n for n in nodes if isinstance(n, ast.Constant)
246	                    and n.value == old_cfg.get("key_env")]
247	        if not (url_lits or url_consts) or not key_lits:
248	            raise EditError(
249	                f"{site.describe()}: the {old_p} client is not created here (no "
250	                f"{'base URL' if not (url_lits or url_consts) else old_cfg.get('key_env')} in "
251	                f"the function), so switching it to {new_p} would also change other code")
252	        spans += [(_span(n), json.dumps(new_cfg["base_url"])) for n in url_lits]
253	        spans += [(_span(n), json.dumps(new_cfg["key_env"])) for n in key_lits]
254	        url_names |= url_consts
255	        spans += [(_span(n), _name_for(n.id, old_p, new_p)) for n in nodes
256	                  if isinstance(n, ast.Name) and isinstance(n.ctx, ast.Load) and n.id in url_consts]
257	    for c in sorted(url_names):
258	        new_name = _name_for(c, old_p, new_p)
259	        uses = [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Name) and n.id == c
260	                and isinstance(n.ctx, ast.Load)
261	                and not any(a <= n.lineno <= b for a, b in ranges)]
262	        if new_name in consts:
263	            raise EditError(f"{path}: {new_name} already exists")
264	        assign = consts[c]
265	        if uses:    # still used elsewhere: keep it, add the new constant below it
266	            indent, nl = " " * assign.col_offset, "\r\n" if "\r\n" in text else "\n"
267	            spans.append(((assign.end_lineno, assign.end_col_offset, assign.end_lineno,
268	                           assign.end_col_offset),
269	                          f"{nl}{indent}{new_name} = {json.dumps(new_cfg['base_url'])}"))
270	            notes.append(f"added {new_name}; {c} is still used elsewhere in {path}")
271	        else:
272	            spans.append((_span(assign), f"{new_name} = {json.dumps(new_cfg['base_url'])}"))
273	            notes.append(f"{c} replaced by {new_name} (no other use in {path})")
274	    after = _replace_spans(text, spans)
275	    if switch_provider:   # comments that name the old key ("starts without GROQ_API_KEY")
276	        old_key, new_key = old_cfg["key_env"], new_cfg["key_env"]
277	        lines = after.splitlines(True)
278	        for a, b in ranges:
279	            for i in range(a - 1, min(b, len(lines))):
280	                lines[i] = re.sub(rf"\b{re.escape(old_key)}\b", new_key, lines[i])
281	        after = "".join(lines)
282	    return after, notes

285	def call_contract(path: Path, symbol: str | None) -> dict:
286	    """What the call site sends, read back from source: model ids, base URLs, key names."""
287	    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
288	    consts = {k: v.value.value for k, v in _module_constants(tree).items()}
289	    fn = _function(tree, symbol)
290	    if fn is None:
291	        raise EditError(f"{path.name}: {symbol} not found after the edit")
292	    found = {"model": set(), "base_url": set(), "key_env": set()}
293	    for n in ast.walk(fn):
294	        if isinstance(n, ast.keyword) and n.arg in ("model", "base_url"):
295	            v = n.value
296	            value = v.value if isinstance(v, ast.Constant) else consts.get(getattr(v, "id", ""))
297	            if isinstance(value, str):
298	                found[n.arg].add(value)
299	        if isinstance(n, ast.Subscript) and "environ" in ast.unparse(n.value) \
300	                and isinstance(n.slice, ast.Constant):
301	            found["key_env"].add(n.slice.value)
302	        if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and ast.unparse(n.func).endswith(("environ.get", "getenv")) \
303	                and n.args and isinstance(n.args[0], ast.Constant):
304	            found["key_env"].add(n.args[0].value)
305	    return {k: sorted(v) for k, v in found.items()}

310	class Resolver:
311	    def __init__(self, project: Path, decision_id: int, opts: ResolveOptions,
312	                 tracer: Tracer | None = None, ask=input, out=print, client=None, entire=None):
313	        self.project = Path(project).resolve()
314	        self.decision_id = decision_id
315	        self.opts = opts
316	        self.tracer = tracer
317	        self.ask, self.out = ask, out
318	        self.client = client          # ProviderSet-like; None -> built from the catalog
319	        self.entire = entire
320	        self.state: dict = {"steps": []}
321	        self.snapshots: dict[Path, str | None] = {}   # file -> text before this run (None: new)
322	        self.node_before: dict | None = None
323	        self.start_branch: str | None = None
324	        self.branch: str | None = None
325	        self.created_branch = False
326	
327	    # --- plumbing ---------------------------------------------------------------------
328	
329	    def _say(self, msg: str = "") -> None:
330	        self.out(msg)
331	
332	    def _ask_yes(self, question: str) -> bool:
333	        try:
334	            return self.ask(question).strip().lower() in ("y", "yes")
335	        except EOFError:
336	            return False
337	
338	    def _step(self, name: str, fn):
339	        """Run one step as its own span; retry once with the error, then fail."""
340	        focus, reason = STEPS[name]
341	        error = None
342	        for attempt in (1, 2):
343	            with self.tracer.step(name, focus, reason=reason, attrs={"attempt": attempt}):
344	                self.tracer.annotate({"nbd.resolve_step": name, "nbd.resolve_attempt": attempt,
345	                                      "notbydefault.decision_id": self.decision_id})
346	                try:
347	                    result = fn(error)
348	                    self.state["steps"].append({"step": name, "focus_area": focus,
349	                                                "attempts": attempt, "status": "ok"})
350	                    return result
351	                except Stop as s:
352	                    self.state["steps"].append({"step": name, "focus_area": focus,
353	                                                "attempts": attempt, "status": f"stop: {s}"})
354	                    self.tracer.annotate({"nbd.resolve_outcome": "stop"})
355	                    raise
356	                except Exception as e:     # noqa: BLE001  (every failure gets one retry)
357	                    error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
358	                    self.tracer.annotate({"nbd.resolve_error": error})
359	                    if attempt == 1:
360	                        self.tracer.event("retry_step", "recovery",
361	                                          f"{name} failed ({error}); retrying once with the error",
362	                                          step=name)
363	                        self._say(f"  ! {name} failed: {error}. Retrying once.")
364	        self.state["steps"].append({"step": name, "focus_area": focus, "attempts": 2,
365	                                    "status": f"failed: {error}"})
366	        self.tracer.event("step_failed", "recovery", f"{name} failed twice: {error}", step=name)
367	        raise StepFailed(name, error)

369	    def _snapshot(self, path: Path) -> None:
370	        """Remember a file as it was before this run first wrote it (None: it didn't exist)."""
371	        path = Path(path)
372	        if path not in self.snapshots:
373	            self.snapshots[path] = read_raw(path) if path.exists() else None
374	
375	    def _write(self, path: Path, text: str) -> None:
376	        self._snapshot(path)
377	        Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
378	        write_raw(path, text)

380	    def _rel(self, path: Path) -> str:

383	        except ValueError:
384	            return str(path)

386	    # --- run ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
387	
388	    def run(self) -> int:
389	        if not db_path(self.project).exists():
390	            self._say(f"No Decision Graph at {db_path(self.project)}.")
391	            return 1
392	        with Graph.for_project(self.project) as g:
393	            d = g.get_node(self.decision_id)
394	        if d is None or d["type"] != "decision":
395	            self._say(f"No decision #{self.decision_id} in {self.project}")
396	            return 1
397	        self.tracer = self.tracer or make_tracer(d.get("session_id"))
398	        mode = "apply" if self.opts.apply else "dry-run"
399	        code = 0
400	        with self.tracer.root("notbydefault.resolve", {
401	                "notbydefault.decision_id": self.decision_id, "nbd.resolve_mode": mode,
402	                "notbydefault.literal": d["label"]},
403	                finish=lambda: {"nbd.resolve_outcome": self.state.get("outcome"),
404	                                "nbd.resolve_branch": self.branch}):
405	            try:
406	                for name in STEPS:
407	                    if name == "branch" and not self.opts.apply:
408	                        break
409	                    self._step(name, getattr(self, f"step_{name}"))
410	                self.state["outcome"] = "resolved"
411	            except Stop as s:
412	                self.state["outcome"] = "stopped"
413	                code = s.code
414	                self._say(str(s))
415	            except StepFailed as f:
416	                self.state["outcome"] = f"failed at {f.step}"
417	                code = 3
418	                self._say(self._fail_message(f))
419	            except GitError as e:      # a branch/rollback git error outside a step
420	                self.state["outcome"] = "failed"
421	                code = 3
422	                self._say(f"Stopped: {e}")
423	        self.tracer.flush()
424	        return code

439	                "failure bank",

441	                "3. recommend: verdict -> edits at every call site this decision owns",
442	                ("4. on approval: branch nbd/<id>-<slug>, apply, run tests and verifiers, "
443	                 "write the record and PR description; commit only if you say yes"
444	                 if self.opts.apply else
445	                 "4. dry run: show the diff and stop (nothing is written; --apply to change "
446	                 "files)")]
447	        self.tracer.annotate({"notbydefault.plan": "\n".join(plan)})

451	    def step_investigate(self, error) -> None:
452	        from notbydefault import records as records_mod
453	        from notbydefault.affected import Index, analyze
454	        from notbydefault.fit import failures as failures_mod
455	        from notbydefault.fit.run import graph_context
456	        from notbydefault.graph import affected_entries
457	        d = self.decision
458	        with Graph.for_project(self.project) as g:
459	            ctx = graph_context(g, d)
460	            if error is None:
461	                res = analyze(Index(self.project, self.entire), d)
462	                entries, source, note = res.entries, res.source, res.note
463	                if source != "entire-graph" and d["data"].get("affected_code"):
464	                    entries, source = affected_entries(d), "stored entire-graph analysis"
465	                    note += f"; using the analysis stored at {d['data'].get('affected_at')}"
466	            else:     # retry: the analysis stored on the decision by the last check/affected
467	                entries, source = affected_entries(d), "stored analysis (retry)"
468	                note = f"live Entire Graph read failed ({error})"
469	                self.tracer.event("affected_code_fallback", "recovery", note)
470	            others = [o for o in g.nodes("decision") if o["id"] != d["id"]
471	                      and (o["label"] == d["label"]
472	                           or set(o["data"].get("files") or []) & {e["path"] for e in entries})]
473	            past = []
474	            for o in others:
475	                rejects = [a["label"] for a in g.neighbors(o["id"], ("rejects",))]
476	                rec = records_mod.existing_path(self.project, o)
477	                past.append({"id": o["id"], "label": o["label"], "files": o["data"].get("files")
478	                             or [o["data"].get("file")], "status": o["data"].get("status"),
479	                             "verdict": o["data"].get("verdict"),
480	                             "recommended": o["data"].get("recommended"), "rejects": rejects,
481	                             "record": self._rel(rec) if rec else None})
482	            own_record = records_mod.existing_path(self.project, d)
483	            from notbydefault.briefing import build
484	            briefing = build(self.project, g, d, limit=None)
485	        bank = failures_mod.load(self.project, self.decision_id)
486	        by_model: dict[str, int] = {}
487	        for r in bank:
488	            by_model[r.get("model", "?")] = by_model.get(r.get("model", "?"), 0) + 1
489	        own_files = set(d["data"].get("files") or [d["data"].get("file")])
490	        direct, excluded, callers = [], [], []
491	        for e in entries:
492	            site = Site(e["path"], e.get("symbol"), e.get("line"), e.get("via", ""))
493	            if e.get("depth", 0) > 0:
494	                callers.append(site)
495	                continue
496	            owner = next((o for o in past if o["label"] == d["label"] and e["path"] in o["files"]
497	                          and e["path"] not in own_files), None)
498	            if owner:
499	                excluded.append((site, owner))
500	            else:
501	                direct.append(site)
502	        self.inv = {"ctx": ctx, "entries": entries, "source": source, "note": note,
503	                    "past": past, "own_record": self._rel(own_record) if own_record else None,
504	                    "briefing": briefing, "bank": bank, "bank_by_model": by_model,
505	                    "sites": direct, "excluded": excluded, "callers": callers}
506	        self.tracer.event("affected_code", "context" if source == "entire-graph" else "recovery",
507	                          f"{len(direct)} call site(s) to change, {len(excluded)} owned by other "
508	                          f"decisions, {len(callers)} caller(s) ({source})",
509	                          sites=[s.describe() for s in direct])
510	        self._say(f"\nInvestigate")
511	        self._say(f"  goal: {ctx['goal'] or '-'}; constraints: {'; '.join(ctx['constraints']) or '-'}")
512	        self._say(f"  affected code ({source}{': ' + note if note else ''}):")
513	        for s in direct:
514	            self._say(f"    change  {s.describe():<40} {s.via}")
515	        for s, o in excluded:
516	            self._say(f"    leave   {s.describe():<40} owned by decision #{o['id']}"
517	                      + (f" ({o['record']})" if o["record"] else ""))
518	        for s in callers:

894	    (None, why not)."""

899	        return None, f"decision is stale: {data.get('stale_reason')}"
900	    if not data.get("verdict") or not data.get("results"):
901	        return None, "no fit check yet"

912	    vpath = verifiers_mod.verifier_path(Path(project), decision["id"])
913	    if vpath.exists() and verifiers_mod.load(vpath).sha != res["verifiers"].get("sha"):

  3. their transcripts (`entire checkpoint explain <id> --transcript`): user/assistant text that

     quote isn't in the transcripts, or that the existing test inputs already cover, is dropped
  5. the rest are saved as "suggested" verifier cases in .notbydefault/suggested/<id>.jsonl;

                        r"what if|what about|fails?|crash|error|retry|timeout|rate limit|"
                        r"multilingual|language|cancel+ed|ambiguous|relative date|not tested|"
                        r"untested|corner case)\b", re.IGNORECASE)
MAX_EXCERPT_CHARS = 9000
MAX_CHECKPOINTS = 5

                "may not be tested. Answer with one JSON object only.")
SCOUT_PROMPT = """Feature under test: {feature}
Code: {code}

Existing test inputs (truncated):
{tests}

Conversation excerpts (from Entire checkpoints):
{excerpts}

from the excerpts that raise it (copy them verbatim, 3 to 20 words), and say whether the existing

             "evidence": "<verbatim quote>", "already_tested": true or false}}]}}"""


def _text(message) -> str:
    content = (message or {}).get("content") if isinstance(message, dict) else message
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        return "\n".join(c.get("text", "") for c in content
                         if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("type") == "text")
    return ""


def excerpts(transcript: list[dict], needles: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """User/assistant text that mentions the code or an edge-case word."""
    out = []
    for row in transcript:
        if row.get("type") not in ("user", "assistant"):

        text = _text(row.get("message")).strip()
        if not text or text.startswith("<"):

        if any(n and n.lower() in text.lower() for n in needles) and EDGE_WORDS.search(text):

    return out


def _norm(s: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", s.lower()).split())

def _prefix(project: Path) -> str:

                  corpus: str) -> list[dict]:
    from notbydefault.llm import parse_json
    reply = caller.chat(model, [
        {"role": "system", "content": SCOUT_SYSTEM},
        {"role": "user", "content": SCOUT_PROMPT.format(
            feature=feature, code=code,
            tests="\n".join(f"- {t[:160]}" for t in tests[:40]) or "(none)", excerpts=corpus)}],
        span="notbydefault.scout", role="scout", max_tokens=3000, json_mode=True,
        focus_area="tool_use")
    return parse_json(reply.text).get("cases") or []


def verify_cases(cases: list[dict], texts: list[str], corpus: str, decision_id: int,
                 tracer) -> list[dict]:
    """Keep cases whose quote is really in the transcripts and that aren't tested yet."""
    hay = _norm(corpus)
    kept = []
    for case in cases:
        quote = str(case.get("evidence") or "")
        if not quote or _norm(quote) not in hay:
            tracer.event("drop_unquoted_case", "recovery",
                         f"dropped {case.get('input')!r}: its quote isn't in the transcripts")
            continue
        if case.get("already_tested"):
            tracer.event("drop_tested_case", "verification",
                         f"dropped {case.get('input')!r}: existing inputs cover it")
            continue
        cp = next((t.split(")", 1)[0].removeprefix("(checkpoint ") for t in texts
                   if _norm(quote) in _norm(t)), None)
        kept.append({"input": str(case.get("input")), "why": str(case.get("why") or ""),
                     "evidence": quote, "checkpoint": cp, "status": "suggested",
                     "decision_id": decision_id,
                     "found_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")})
    return kept


def save(project: Path, decision_id: int, kept: list[dict]) -> tuple[Path, list[dict]]:
    path = suggested_path(project, decision_id)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    old = ([json.loads(l) for l in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if l.strip()]
           if path.exists() else [])
    have = {_norm(o["input"]) for o in old}
    new = [k for k in kept if _norm(k["input"]) not in have]
    with open(path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for k in new:
            f.write(json.dumps(k, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    return path, new


def read_transcripts(project: Path, entire, touching, needles, tracer):
    texts, sources = [], []
    for cid, c, touched in touching:
        rows = entire.checkpoint_transcript(cid, project)
        if rows is None:

                         f"checkpoint {cid}: {entire.last_error()}; skipped")
